svg.title: The Lassa Collection — Fermin Lassa, DevOps engineer. Selected works, 2019 – today.

div.p: An exhibition of systems built, broken and repaired by a DevOps engineer in Spain. Most of the works still run. Some of them should not.
Security checks moved to the start of the release process, where problems are cheap. Note how each bar has moved left.
Conservation note. Occasionally blocks a Friday deploy. This is considered a feature.
Cat. 01 · Commissioned by Veridas, DevOps engineer since March 2022.
Terraform, AWS, a little GCP, pull requests
Infrastructure that only changes through pull requests: lint, validate, deploy. Reusable modules, checked by testing.
Conservation note. Manual changes in the cloud console are treated as vandalism.
A space shooter. What hangs here is a portrait; the original is playable online.
Conservation note. Highest score, held by the artist: 2,147,483,647. Unverified.
Cat. 06 · Also on display: TLMgram, livEvent, 100tipy, OSniffy.
Conservation note. Coffee, four a day, is load-bearing.

The full collection is open at fermin.lassa.es.
Monday – Friday, 9:00 – 17:00 (UTC +1). Admission free.
Note. There is no Room 3. Please do not try the door.
